audit_items.proof_trace: The stem-bot-v2 `updateNickname` endpoint is a trusted internal service protected by a shared Bearer token; it carries no per-user ownership check by design. All 5 callers of `syncDiscordNickname` in `stem-system/src/lib/actions/members.ts` enforce ownership at the application layer: user-facing paths (registerNewMember L321, resyncDiscordMember L377, updateMyProfile L414) derive `discord_uid` exclusively from the authenticated user's OAuth-bound `provider_id` or a RLS-scoped DB lookup, while admin paths (updateMemberAdmin L475, renameGraduatesToNewFormat L778) are gated by `checkAdmin()` which performs a fresh DB query. The Bearer token is a server-side env var not accessible to end users, so no direct call to the bot API is possible from outside stem-system.
